name: Harrison Butker

background.fact: Born July 14, 1995 in Decatur, Georgia, to Harrison Butker Sr. and Elizabeth Keller Butker; he has an older sister, and his mother is a clinical medical physicist at Emory.
At The Westminster Schools he played football (picked up as a sophomore), basketball and soccer, won three state soccer titles, and played tuba in the symphonic band.
He played at Georgia Tech from 2013 to 2016, became the school's all-time leading scorer, was a senior captain, and graduated in industrial engineering.
Carolina took him in the seventh round (pick 233) of the 2017 draft; he has been a Chiefs kicker since 2017 and has won three Super Bowls with them.
He led the NFL in scoring in 2019, and Wikipedia lists his career field goal rate as 87.3 percent, fifth best in NFL history (the page does not say as of when).
Listed at 6 ft 4 in, 205 lb, age 31, jersey 7, depth chart K1.

family.fact: Wikipedia says he is married. Nothing further about family is recorded here.
He is co-founder, president and chief operating officer of MDKeller, whose subsidiaries include the menswear company Shepherd's.

recent_events.fact: Butker is 12 of 19 on field goals and 22 of 23 on extra points through 8 games in 2026, for 66 fantasy points (8.25 a game); 6 of his 7 misses came from 50 yards or more.
Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Wednesday, "I'm gonna stick with Butker this week," and Justin Tucker remains on the practice squad as an option; the team appears to be evaluating the kicker weekly.

scouts_read: Butker is set to kick on Sunday, but his hold on the job is the real story. Reid and Toub backed him publicly, while Tucker waits on the practice squad. The game is indoors in Atlanta with Kansas City a field goal favorite, so conditions are fair and the volume should be normal. His 2026 trouble is mostly long kicks, with 6 of his 7 misses from 50 or more, so the shape of the drives matters more than the weather. I would project about 7 points with a floor near 3 if he misses early and a ceiling around 13 if the offense stalls near midfield.
